Dated 18.04.2023 Passed In Lac No.624 Of 2020 And Etc.
 This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sachin Shankar Magadum
 Oral Judgment
(PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM)
The present appeal, filed under Section 74(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, challenges the judgment and award dated 18.04.2023 in LAC No.624/2020.
This Court, following the Division Bench ruling in MFA No.102543/2022 dated 23.09.2024, holds that the NC:
2024:KHC-K:10149 limitation period under the Act is mandatory and non- extendable.
opennyai_summary.decision:
However, the appeal is filed after a delay of 298 days beyond the statutory limitation period of 120 days prescribed under Section 74(1) of the Act.
Relying on precedents, including Union of India vs. Popular Construction Co. and State of Kerala vs. V.R.
Kalliyanikutty (AIR 1999 SC 1305), the appeal is dismissed as time-barred, without addressing the merits.
Parties shall bear their respective costs.
In view of disposal of main appeal, pending applications, if any, stand rejected.
The Court fee paid, if any, shall be refunded in accordance with law.
